recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a current generated profile page later shows constraints or terminology bindings for a 0..0 element, investigate the current Kindling/IG Publisher tooling dependency rather than changing HL7/fhir core source.
issue_request: FHIR-5922 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core FHIR-I issue raised against DSTU1 profile rendering. It reported that base invariants and terminology bindings still displayed for MedicationStatement.reasonNotGiven in a DAF profile even though that element was constrained to 0..0, and asked to suppress invariants and bindings for profile-suppressed elements.
initial_application: Git-svn commit c635a5774f436cc921efa3f96a2883293995dbc1 (#5922, SVN revision 5003) applied the issue by changing the old in-repository PageProcessor so terminology bindings are collected only when ed.hasBinding() and max is not 0, and constraints are listed only for snapshot elements whose max is not 0.
additional_context: The current HL7/fhir checkout delegates publishing to the external Kindling dependency (1.25.5-SNAPSHOT), and the current Kindling PageProcessor source still contains the same max != 0 filters. The original DAF/QICore profile context is not in current core build scope, and current MedicationStatement source has MedicationStatement.reason rather than the old reasonNotGiven element. Related issues FHIR-5926 and FHIR-8736 already have separate combined-branch audit commits.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The historical rendering defect is already applied, the current publisher dependency retains the required behavior, and the old affected profile/element is not an editable current-core artifact.
